name: Soul Breaker
notes: Male Soul Breaker (Kamael Soldier male -> Trooper -> Soul Breaker). The skill list is identical to the female one (class 129); the guide table is the same.

Playstyle: dark magic nuker and debuffer with a rapier melee backup. Surrender to Dark (−30 dark resist) stacks with the dark (UNHOLY) nukes: Abyssal Blaze, Dark Explosion, Soul of Pain, Dark Flame, Annihilation Circle. Dark Weapon adds +20 dark attack power (attacker element power also boosts same-element skills: unc).
The magic skills have no weapon requirement; melee skills need a rapier.

rows.trig: Core single: open with Fallen Arrow (wind magic, 600 range, 2 s). If you wield an ancient sword, Fallen Attack fails, so use Fallen Arrow as the opener and filler and auto-attack otherwise. With a sword, open with Fallen Arrow and then spam Fallen Attack.
Core single: with a sword / blunt / rapier, open with Fallen Arrow and then spam Fallen Attack (melee, 3 s). Requires sword/blunt/rapier, not an ancient sword (it fails with one).
Core single: with an ancient sword Fallen Attack fails, so Fallen Arrow is the filler (auto-attack otherwise).
Toggle: Dark Blade. Always on (owner rule: toggles only in fights).
Never auto: Dark Strike (no ancient sword on this path).
rows.why: no ancient sword on the Soul Breaker path

rows.trig: Never auto: Rush.
Never auto: Disarm.
Debuff opener (non-trash): Surrender to Dark (900 range), then Death Mark. Recast when they expire (30 s each).
Debuff opener (non-trash): after Surrender to Dark, Death Mark (600 range, DoT plus P.Def/M.Def −23%, 70%). Recast when it expires (30 s). Death Mark also enables Checkmate.

when.text: after the debuffs (Surrender to Dark, Death Mark) are up

rows.trig: Core single magic: Curse of Divinity (66+, damage scales with the number of debuffs on the target, 4 s). Cast Curse of Divinity after the debuffs are up.
Core single magic: Soul of Pain (dark magic, 700 range, 3 s) as filler spam.

when.text: a mob is in melee, or the bot plays melee

rows.trig: Core single melee (rapier): Checkmate (52+, needs Death Mark) → Shining Edge → Triple Thrust. When a mob is in melee or the bot plays melee ("Death Mark + Checkmate + Shining Edge" combo).

when.text: a mob is in melee, or the bot plays melee

rows.trig: Core single melee (rapier): Checkmate → Shining Edge (49+, blow) → Triple Thrust. When a mob is in melee or the bot plays melee.

when.text: a mob is in melee, or the bot plays melee

rows.trig: Core single melee (rapier): Checkmate → Shining Edge → Triple Thrust. When a mob is in melee or the bot plays melee.
AoE: Annihilation Circle (58+, r150 around the target, 500 range, 5 s). Use at 3+ clustered. This is the main ranged AoE.

when.text: mobs in front of me at close range

rows.trig: AoE: Dark Flame (46+, frontal fan r200×180°, 40% slow, 4 s). Use at 3+ mobs in front at close range.
AoE: Spread Wing (52+, point-blank r150, physical). Use at 3+ mobs on you.

when.text: not in combat, or the target HP is high

rows.trig: Use the global rules: auto-use when souls < 5 && HP > 70% && (not in combat || target HP high). Costs 193 to 328 HP for 1 to 5 souls, 11 s reuse, cannot be cast at 40 souls. Keep ≥ 5 souls for full nuke power.

when.text: before a pull or a raid; needs 10 Spirit Ore

rows.trig: Use the global rules: before a pull or a raid when souls < 10 and Spirit Ore (3031) >= 10. Gives +50 souls (capped), costs 10 Spirit Ore and 200 HP, 30 min reuse. Keep ≥ 5 souls for full nuke power.

when.text: no other weapon-element buff (Holy / Fire / Ice / Wind / Earth Weapon) on the target

rows.trig: Party/self buff: Dark Weapon (46+, +20 dark attack, 20 min, 400 range, target). Self plus party melee, if no other weapon-element buff is on them.

when.text: only on myself and Kamael party members; recast every 3 min

rows.trig: Party/self buff: Pride of Kamael (49+, +10% P.Atk/M.Atk/blow rate only with ancient sword, crossbow or rapier, 3 min, 30 s reuse). Self plus Kamael party members, recast every 3 min. Useless on non-Kamael.
Self-buff: Soul to Empower (MA_UP). Only if there is no board Empower.
Toggle: Dark Armor. Always on (owner rule: toggles only in fights).
Control: Shadow Bind (52+, root 15 s, 400 range). Root a melee mob to kite it (solo).
Control: Voice Bind (58+, silence 20 s). On caster mobs.
Control: Soul Web (62+, AoE slow r200, 60 s). When kiting several mobs.
Party debuff: Curse of Life Flow (60+, party members heal when they hit the target, 30 s). On a boss or raid target in a party.
Emergency: Painkiller (58+, 8 s damage and debuff immunity, 5 min). When HP < 20%.
Emergency: Blink (60+, point-blank stun r150 plus blink 400 backwards). When 2+ mobs are on you and you are low. (unc: the blink can land in walls; risky for pathing)

when.text: I carry root, slow, silence or poison

rows.trig: Emergency: Soul Cleanse (66+). When debuffed by root, slow, silence or poison.
Never auto: Steal Divinity (steals buffs; PvP or buffed raids only).
Never auto: Protection from Darkness (only vs dark-damage bosses; it shares a slot with Surrender to Dark).
rows.why: only vs dark-damage bosses; slot shared with Surrender to Dark
